data.title: kadence init asks questions only of a person at a terminal; anything else gets none and is told what to do next
data.why: A question an agent cannot answer hangs it until a timeout (claude-code#30555) and in a neighbour exited 0 having created nothing (Backlog.md#1012). So any doubt means no question: a pipe on either side, any flag, CI, an agent marker. The person gets the guided setup the prototype recorded; the agent gets the same steps as instructions in the output it reads.
data.rejected: A separate onboard or setup command: Beads users lost hours between init, setup, onboard and prime (#2938) — one verb; An --interactive flag to opt in: a person trying the tool for the first time would never find it; Asking whenever stdin is a TTY: an agent in a pty would hang
